title: Archetype Raillet: Compact workspace + routing synthesis
creator: Maya Singh
description: Synthesize a compact sidebar pattern ("Raillet") that unifies workspace switching, per-route rollouts, and a lightweight cost lens. Goal is to reduce clicks to switch workspace or fallback routes, expose rollout state and cost per-route, and provide a keyboard-first flow for power users. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma screens, interactive prototype, IA diagram, and handoff tokens/specs for frontend and PM review.
acceptance_criteria: Compact rail exposes workspace selector, active route chip, and cost micrograph in a single collapsed column
Keyboard nav: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens command palette with workspace jump shortcuts and rollout toggles
Canary and A/B rollout states displayed on route chip with hover details and link to rollout dashboard
Design tokens and spacing documented for implementation; responsive behavior defined for widths < 980px
Usability test (n=6) median task completion time for switching workspace < 6s
design_decisions: Use a two-tier raillet: collapsed icons + inline chip row on hover/expand to keep vertical real-estate minimal
Route chips are micro-containers showing model/route name, rollout badge (icon), and cost badge (estimated tokens/minute)
Workspace switch remains top-most control and is sticky; recent workspaces appear in a quick-jump flyout
Integrate rollout quick-actions (promote, pause, inspect) inside chip contextual menu rather than main toolbar to reduce clutter
Cost lens uses sparkline micrographs with 3-state color coding (ok/warning/high) tied to token-rate thresholds from Optimize service
tradeoffs: Pros: compact layout reduces horizontal noise and surfaces operational controls closer to where users reason about routes
Cons: increased cognitive load for new users—solution mitigated by an onboarding tooltip and first-run walkthrough
Performance: chip hover panels require lazy-loading rollout metadata; eng impact: additional API endpoints or caching required
Accessibility: condensed chips risk smaller hit targets; mitigated by larger hover targets and keyboard affordances
usability_findings: Participants (n=6) found workspace quick-jump faster than topbar modal in 5/6 tasks
Confusion observed around rollout badges — added explicit tooltip with plain text (Canary 10%, A/B buckets) improved comprehension
Cost micrograph appreciated, but users want an explainer linking sparkline to billing: added direct link to cost breakdown panel
Mobile view: participants expected workspace switching in a bottom sheet not in rail; flagged for mobile-specific pattern
next_steps: Finalize Figma frames with responsive variants and accessibility annotations
Sync with Eng on API contract for rollout metadata and token-rate micro-metrics (schedule meeting 2025-10-15)
Create GH issue for console-side rendering components and add as dependency
Prepare handoff docs and attach CSS tokens, color states, and ARIA guidance by 2025-10-18
